parsed.why: Decriminalised plus criminalised orientation-discrimination, but no trans-specific protections, documented persistent discrimination, and a 2024 state police assault and arbitrary detention of a trans woman under investigation; conservative society, no documented facility or border bans.

Self-ID recognition, marriage equality, criminalised hate speech, national action plan and support services; no visitor-facing restrictions. Downsides are rising LGBT-wide hate-crime reports without denominators and cantonal variation in detention wording — paper gaps, not traveller exposure.

Sodomy law strengthened in 2022 reaching trans people by birth-sex reading, no recognition or anti-discrimination law, documented state torture in custody, psychiatric confinement and impunity, state media and no civil society — hostile institutions throughout.

Gender expression itself criminalised with multi-year convictions, same-sex conduct criminalised, healthcare and recognition banned, advocacy criminal, plus a documented first-hand border strip-search of a genderqueer visitor — universal state exposure with active enforcement.

Anti-discrimination act expressly covering gender identity in goods and services, no entry obstacles, functioning regional recourse; offset by hostile political climate, a lethal LGBT-venue shooting, regressive bills and low public acceptance — friction and hostility, not state exclusion.
